title: Characterizing the role of reasoning tokens in large language models as state over tokens
title_zh: 大型语言模型中推理token的角色表征：基于token的状态
abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on generating reasoning tokens that appear to describe a reasoning process performed by the model to arrive at the answer. However, empirical evidence reveals that when read as text, these tokens are not a faithful explanation of the model’s actual reasoning process. To address this gap between appearance and function, we introduce the State over Tokens (SoT) conceptual framework. SoT reframes reasoning tokens not as a linguistic narrative, but as an externalized computational state—the mechanism that persists the computation across the separate generation cycles. The SoT framing explains how the tokens can drive correct reasoning without being a faithful explanation when read as text and surfaces previously overlooked research questions on these tokens. We discuss how it dispels two common misconceptions: that the text records the complete process, and that the model uses the words with the meanings a human reader ascribes to them. We argue that this framing offers a fruitful way to think about these tokens, one that captures their mechanics accurately while remaining simple and intuitive, and that adopting it opens research directions. To better understand the mechanism of large-language-model reasoning, research should move beyond reading the tokens as text and also focus on decoding them as state. When large language models ‘reason’ about a problem, they might still solve it differently from what their reasoning transcript suggest. In this Perspective, Levy et al. describe how one can start investigating the role of these reasoning tokens.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型越来越依赖生成推理token，这些token似乎描述了模型为得出答案而执行的推理过程。然而，实证证据表明，作为文本阅读时，这些token并非模型实际推理过程的忠实解释。为了弥合外观与功能之间的差距，我们引入了“基于token的状态”(SoT)概念框架。SoT将推理token重新定义为非语言叙事，而是作为外部化的计算状态——持续跨生成周期持续计算的机制。SoT的表征解释了token如何在不作为文本被读取时驱动正确的推理，并揭示了此前被忽视的研究问题。我们讨论了它如何消除两种常见的误解：即文本记录了完整过程，以及模型使用的词汇具有人类读者赋予的含义。我们认为，这种框架为思考这些token提供了一种既能准确捕捉其机制又又简单直观的方式，采用它也开辟了研究方向。为了更好地理解大型语言模型推理的机制，研究应超越将token作为文本阅读的视角，同时也应关注将其解码为状态。当大型语言模型‘推理’一个问题时，它们可能仍然以不同于其推理转述的方式来解决问题。在本观点文章中，Levy等人描述了如何开始研究这些推理token的作用。
